tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bla ma yang tig yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang bskur gyi zin

tho skal bzang dga' ba'i mgul rgyan don la rton pa'i yi ge bzhugs so/ / shes bya thams cad mkhyen gzigs dgongs klong chub/ /'od gsal rdzogs chen shing rta 'khor los sgyur/ /dri med 'od zer gangs can bstan pa'i mgon/ /dbyer med rdo rje bla ma snying dbus rol/ /man ngag snying thig bka' gter gnad dril ba/ /bla ma yang tig yid bzhin nor bu yi/ /dbang gi lag len zin tho spel ba la/ /gnang ba'i skabs dbye byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ / de la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po la gnyis/ bla slob kyi rten 'brel brtag pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor bsham bkod sogs kyi rim pa gzhung nas ji skad bshad pa ltar las/ de la'ang spros pa rgyas bsdus yul dang dus kyi khyad par te/ slob dpon lta dgongs gding du gyur cing spros pa la mi dga' ba dag gis tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ 'bring gi chu tshon/ tha mas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gsungs mod kyang*/ bskur yul slob ma'i rtog pa bsal byed kyi long skabs dang 'byor pa yod na dkyil 'khor mchod pa sogs gsang sngags kyi che ba yin pas spros rgyas byas na legs so/ /gang ltar yang phyi nang gi mchod pa/ rtsa gsum spyi'i gtor ma/ bka' srung gi mchod gtor/ tshogs kyi yo byad sngon gtor gnyis sogs lha'i nyer spyod/ ḍā dril sogs bdag gi nyer spyod rnams 'du bya/ gnyis pa cho ga gong mtshungs ltar las 'di dbang po dang spros pa 'bring gi dbang du byas na/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang brgyud 'debs rgyas bsdus skabs bstun sngon du 'gro bas/ dngos gzhi la bdag bum gnyis las/ dang po la'ang skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ rlung lnga rnam dag dwangs ma'i sku/ /nyon mongs rnam dag ye shes lnga/ /sku gsum mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i/ /dkon mchog gsum la rtogs pas 'dud/ / ces lan gsum/ sems bskyed thun mong ba ni/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams/

/ye nas sangs rgyas yin pa la/ /rtog pa'i dbang gis 'khor ba las/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ / lan gsum/ khyad par gyi sems bskyed ni/ bsam du med de sems nyid nam mkha' che/ /sems nyid nam mkha' bsam pa kun dang bral/ /bsam du med pa'i sems nyid nam mkha' ni/ /nam mkha' mi dmigs pa yang dmigs su med/ /oṃ dharmā dha tu dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma rdor dril bcas snying kha phyag rgya bca'/ mchan/ ko3 haṃ/ zhes mi dmigs pa'i ngang du dal gcig gzhag la/ slar rig gdangs chu las nya 'phar ba bzhin du/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad ye shes kyi me ri me dpung 'bar ba'i klong nas/ rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur bla re mtshon cha'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal che mchog he ru ka sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dung khrag 'dzin pa/ dpal gyi chas dang ldan pa/ yab yum gyi skur gyur par bsams la/ dkar gtor la dmigs te/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsangs/ oṃ āḥ hūm̐ lan gsum gyis sbyangs spel bsgyur la/ bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod du gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza: bhū mi pa ti sa pā ri wā ra na ma: sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas lan gsum spel/ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twat+ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ gang zhig 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ /sngags spyod don du sa phyogs 'di/ /bdag zhu khyod kyis gnang bar mdzod/ / ces dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/

/rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*/ /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang*/ /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*/ /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshim can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*/ /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*/ /'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod/ / ces gtor ma mchod/ bgegs gtor la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐hoḥ sa phyag rgya dang bcas lan gsum gyis brlab/ oṃ sarba bhū ta a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ sa bkug / na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+ya: sarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇa daṃ ba l+ya de swā hā/ sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas spel/ sarba bhu ta bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi sa bsngos na/ de nas bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni/ e ma nga ni rang byung ba/ /khro rgyal dpal chen nyid kyi sku/ /dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs/ /'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du song*/ /ci ste 'gro bar mi byed na/ /mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing*/ /lus ni dum bu stong du gtubs/ /oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ zhes dang sum+bha ni sogs kyis bskrad la gtor ma phyi rol du dor ste phyi'i bgegs bsal/ nang gi bgegs dbyings su bsal ba ni/ rnam par rtog pa bgegs yin te/ / bgegs ni rang gi sems las byung*/ /ye nas sems nyid dag ce na/ / bgegs zhes bya ba gzhan na med/ /badz+ra āt+ma ko3haṃ/ mtshan bcas kyi srung ba ni/ hūm̐/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams ye shes me dpung 'bar/ /rdo rje'i ra ba drwa ba gur dang ni/ /bla bre mtshon cha'i 'khor los nam mkha' khyab/

/khro bo khro mo dpal chen rngams pa'i tshogs/ /sprin phung 'khrigs shing hūm̐ sgra di ri ri/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ mtshan med kyi srung ba ni/ a: ming dang mtshan mar ma grub pa'i/ /mi gnas mi 'bral 'dus ma byas/ /chos kyi dbyings kyis bsrungs pas na/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs so/ /dz+nyā na badz+ra rak+ṣa a haṃ/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgya snying khar sbyar/ mchan/ zhes pas dbyings su la bzla'o/ zhes mtshams bcad do/ /de nas bdag bskyed dngos ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi zla'i dbus su rang nyid skad cig gis gzhi'i kun tu bzang po nam mkha' dwangs pa'i mdog ltar zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gis yum kun tu bzang mo dkar mo dang 'khril zhing mnyam par sbyor ba/ zhabs rdo rje dang pad+ma'i skyil krung gi bzhugs pa'i sku las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'phro ba snang la rang bzhin med pa wal gyis gsal la/ a: brgya rtsa brgyad sogs brjod/ gnyis pa mdun bskyed bum pa bsgrub pa la/ bum pa lnga yod na dbus dang phyogs bzhir rigs lnga so sor bskyed/ gcig gis 'thus rgyu byas tshe rigs lnga ka chabs cig tu dmigs/ gang ltar yang*/ mdun gyi bum pa mi dmigs pa'i ngang las/ phyi rin po che'i bum pa nang gzhal yas khang bdun rtsi'i chus sum gnyis gang ba'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir seng ge /glang chen/ rta mchog /rma bya/ shang shang gis bteg pa'i khri'i steng du pad+ma dang nyi zla'i gdan la/ dbus su rnam par snang mdzad mthing ka /shar du rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ lhor rin chen 'byung ldan ser po/ nub tu snang ba mtha' yas dmar po/ byang du don yod grub pa ljang gu rnams rang rang gi yum dang bcas rigs kyi phyag mtshan 'dzin zhing longs spyod rdzogs pa'i chas can rang 'od 'phro ba'i klong du bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum dang*/ rang gi sku las 'od zer dpag du med pa 'phros pas nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad khyab pa'i klong na bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs ye shes pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs par dmigs la/

rol mo dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ gdod nas snying po byang chub dang*/ /mi dmigs thugs kyi dkyil 'khor las/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad spyan drang ngo : bdag dang dbyer med brtan par bzhugs: rang rgya bcas mchan/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod pa tsam gyis ye shes pa'i lha tshogs bdag mdun rnams dang dbyer med du gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes ji ltar rigs par bzla'o/ gnyis pa mchod pa 'bul ba la spro na nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya dang*/ mchod pa'i sprin gzungs bcas brjod/ rang gzhung tshogs mchod ltar/ oṃ/ rin chen me tog sogs nas/ bstod pa/ tshogs mchod kyi drang ba'i bar dkrus ltar bya/ rnam bum gyi lha tshogs bde stong gi ngo bor zhu nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par dmigs/ las bum sgrub pa ni/ las bum gyi nang du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljang nag phyag g.yas rdo rje rgya gram phyar zhing g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa khro bo'i chas kun rdzogs par gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sngags kyis bskor ba las bdud rtsi babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ji rigs bzlas mthar/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ hūm̐/ 'jig pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol pa'i lha/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces bstod la yi ge brgya pas nongs bshags phul/ las kyi khro bo dbang gi bya ba mthar ma phyin bar du bzhugs nas sdig sgrib sbyong ba dang bar chad kyi bgegs bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol/ spro na bdag 'jug rig me dor ba sgyu 'phrul ltar bya/ de nas slob ma rnams las slob kyis sgo drung du khrus nas dbyung*/ gral du 'khod pa dang*/ bgegs gtor bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs rnams gong ltar dang*/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas lan gsum spel te bsngo/

mtshan bcas kyi mtshams gcod srung 'khor sogs grub rjes su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras me tog sbyin/ 'o de ltar sgrib pa dag byed khrus nas dbyung ba/ 'du bar mi dbang ba'i bgegs la gtor ma byin zhing bskrad pa/ bar chad mi 'jug pa'i phyir bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa sogs sbyor ba sngon du 'gro ba'i chos rnams grub zin pa lags/ de'ang rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba smin byed dbang la 'jug par 'dod pa dag gi rten 'brel gyi thog mar med du mi rung pa the tshom med pa'i yid ches kyi dad pa brtan po dang*/ theg chen byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa shin tu gal che bas na kun slong 'di ltar bcos par zhu/ 'o nam mkhas gar khyab sems can gyis khyab cing*/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras gnyis kyis rtag tu go skabs med par mnar ba ni/ de yang ngan song gsum sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal mdze thog tu phol mig gi rma byung ba lta bu dang*/ mtho ris gsum 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bum nang du bung ba btsud pa lta bu'o/ /de dag gi rgyu'am rkyen du gyur pa khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyad kyi sgyu rtsal nyes pa'am/ dug can gyi zas la spyod pa lta bu'i khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas ris mtho dman gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin me'i 'obs dang*/ dug sbrul lam gcan gzan gdug pa can gyi tshangs sgor phyin pa lta bu 'di la thog ma med pa'i dus nas da lta'i bar du zo chu'i khyud mo'am/ rdza mkhan gyi 'phang lo ltar yang nas yang du 'khor zhing sdug bsngal rgyun ring la dos drags pa kho nar spyod pa rnams bdag gcig pus bsgral te/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba bla na med pa la dgod par bya snyam pa'i dam bca' ba sngon du 'gro dgos/ de yang smon pa tsam gyis ma yin par rnam mkhyen sgrub pa'i rten bzang dal ba brgyad dang*/

'byor pa bcu legs par tshang ba'i gzhi mi lus rin po che rgyu rdo rje bzhi yi rang bzhin can dang*/ rkyen bla ma rdo rje slob dpon/ thabs zab mo gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa lam bde ba dang myur ba'i khyad chos du mas 'phags pa dang 'phrad pa'i rten 'brel 'di lta bu ni urtuṃ wā ra'i me tog las kyang cher dkon pas na/ de lta bu'i rgyu mtshan shes pa'i dwangs 'dod yid ches kyi dad pas sna drangs te le lo phyir bshol gyi dbang du skad cig kyang mi btang bar brtson 'grus drag po me 'bar ba lta bu'i spro sems dang bcas pa'i sgo nas thar pa'i lam bzang gdams pa zab mo nyams su ma blangs na/ spyir 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad rtag brtan med par skad cig skad cig gis/ 'gyur ba can dang*/ bye brag sdug bden gyis 'phangs pa'i sgyu lus kyi phung po rlung sems kyi 'du ba can 'di dang nam 'bral cha med ma nges pas/ blo sna rbad kyis bstungs te thob bya 'bras bu bla na med pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che yid smon tsam ma yin par myur du thob par bya dgos/ de 'thob byed rgyu rkyen rten 'brel la brten dgos pas na/ de yang thabs tshul theg pa'i 'jug sgo bsam kyis mi khyab pa bzhugs mod kyang*/ mdor bsdu na/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi theg pa gnyis su 'du ba yin te/ da lta skabs su babs pa ni gsang sngags kyi theg pa yin la/ de la'ang phyi bya spyod rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsum dang*/ nang dbang bsgyur thabs kyi theg pa gsum ste drug tu 'dod la/ de la'ang rgya gar na gsang rnying gi ris med kyang*/ 'gyur gyi snga phyis phyes pas 'di ni snga 'gyur rnying ma yin/ de la rang lugs nang rgyud yo ga gsum mam dbang bsgyur thabs kyi theg pa gsum du dbye ba ni/ rgyud bskyed pa ma hā yo ga gzhi lta bu/ lung rdzogs pa a nu yo ga lam lta bu/

man ngag rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga 'bras bu ltar grags pa las/ 'di ni phyi ma ltar dbang bskur ba'i skabs su babs pa lags pas 'di nyid kyi bla ma brgyud pa ni/ dang po chos kyi dbyings spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang nas gzhi'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po yab yum zhal phyag gi rnam par bzhengs te/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rigs lnga yab yum dang*/ drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po la/ rang bzhin gyi byin gyis brlabs kyis bshad/ des thub pa sprul pa'i sku rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ phyag na rdo rje la 'og min gyi gnas su tshig brjod du med pa'i ngang nas rang gi ngo bos gsungs/ des dur khrod me ri 'bar bar sprul pa'i sku slob dpon chen po dga' rab rdo rje la tshig sdeb sbyor legs pa'i sgo nas bshad/ des so sa'i gling du gu ru 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la rang gnad nges pa'i sgo nas bshad/ des rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar mkhas pa shrī singha la yid dpyod blo bral ngang du bshad/ des rgya gar bha seng gi dur khrod du rgyal ba dz+nya na sū tra la rtogs pa mngon gyur gyis bshad/ des rgya gar 'od ma'i tshal du 'pho ba chen po'i skur bzhengs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta bī ma la mi tra la mngon sum rang gnad la phab nas gsungs/ des byar gyi phur brag dkar them pa 'dra bar 'od lus su gshegs pa'i lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug la 'od gsal mngon sum du gtan la phab nas gsungs/ des rta nag zam khar sprul sku rgyal ba zhang ston pa la sku gsum 'du 'bral med par gsungs/ des sprul sku'i bzhugs gnas sgom khang du zhang nyi ma 'bum la 'khor 'das chig rdzogs su gtan la phab nas gsungs/ des skyil sgang dpal gyi gnas mchog tu gu ru jo 'ber la yid dpyod blo dang bral nas mngon sum 'od gsal du gsungs/ des gro bo 'on pa phur 'khrul zhig chen po la dge sdig skyon yon las 'das pa'i ngo bo rjen par gsungs/

des gdan sa dpal gyi seng ge rgyab tu grub chen me long rdo rje la stong sgom mun rdo dang phral nas 'od gsal snying po lnga ldan du gsungs/ des sgrags phu dpal gyi yongs rdzong du 'od gsal rgyun chad med pa'i rigs 'dzin ku ma rā dza la rang gsal 'dzin med chen por gsungs/ des skyam phu dpal gyi dge lding du 'khor 'das chos nyid du grol ba'i rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams bzang po la ma btsal lhun grub kyi dgongs pa rang gnas chen por gsungs shing rdzogs pa chen po'i bka' gter bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol te man ngag snying thig gi shing rta ba sa gsum na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba de nyid kyi bstan bcos ngal bso skor gsum/ mdzod chen bdun/ rang grol skor gsum/ dgongs gter mkha' 'gro yang tig sogs zab cing rgya che ba'i gdams ngag gi rim pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa las/ da res kyi skabs su babs pa ni bram ze snying po grub pa'am/ bde mchog snying po'am slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen sogs su grags pa de nyid kyis/ gdul bya'i blo yul dang mthun pa'i gdams pa ni/ sems sde/ klong sde/ man ngag gi sde zhes gsum du bkral ba las/ 'di ni phyi ma'i dgongs pa ltar lags/ de la'ang nang gses su dbang po'i khyad par la dgongs te/ slob dpon chen po shrī sidhas phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang sde skor tsho bzhir phyes pa'i nang tshan snga ma gsum po zhar la tshangs shing*/ gtso cher yang gsang bla na med pa 'od gsal 'pho ba chen po'i lam mchog man ngag snying thig ces 'phrad pa tsam gyis sangs rgya bar byed pa'i gdams pa zab mo mang du bzhugs pa las skabs su babs pa ni gang gi sku dngos dang khyad par med ces zhal gyis bzhes pa'i bla ma yang tig yid bzhin nor bu zhes bka' gter kun gyi bcud dril brgyud pa gser gyi nyag thag la baiḍūr+ya'i phreng ba brgyus pa lta bu'i brgyud pa'i zam ma chad pa dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du bzhugs pa de nyid kyi sgo nas dbang bskur ba la/

thal 'gyur las/ dbang ni rnam pa bzhi yis kyang*/ /skal ba ldan pa smin par bya/ /spros bcas nyid dang spros med dang*/ /shin tu spros med rab spros med/ /dbye ba bzhi yi tshul gyis ni/ /dad ldan rang rgyud smin par bya/ /zhes pa ltar dbang bzhi rim par 'byung ba lags te/ de la'ang rgyu gnyis rkyen bzhi tshogs pa zhig dgos shing*/ don ni a bhi ṣiñtsa'i sgra gtor ba dang blugs pa la 'jug pas/ slob ma'i rgyud rdo rje bzhi'i rang bzhin du ye nas mtshungs ldan du gnas pa la/ khams kyi dri ma'i sgrib pa gtor zhing*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes sad pa'am blugs pas na gtor blugs sam lhan cig byed pa'i rgyu shes pa'i don yin la/ de la'ang rkyen bzhi tshogs dgos pas rgyu'i rkyen bshad ma thag pa ltar la/ bdag po'i rkyen rdo rje slob dpon dbang gi de nyid la mnga' dbang 'byor bas/ dmigs pa'i rkyen cho ga ltar mtshan ma rdzas dang mtshan med ting 'dzin gyis/ de ma thag pa'i rkyen rgyu bzhis sad par byed pa chan la phab btab pa lta bu'i dbang bzhi so so'i nus pas glo bur gyi dri ma cha dang bcas pa bkrus shing lam sgom rung dang*/ 'bras bu thob rung gi skal pa bzang po rgyud la 'jog pas na dbang zhes grags pa las/ thog mar spros bcas bum dbang zab mo bskur ba la bdag gis bgyi 'os rnams grub zin/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du maṇ+ḍal 'bul pa dang 'dod pa'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa gnyis kyi/ thog mar bla ma brgyud gsum 'dus pa'i ngo bo dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang dbyer med pa'i 'dun pas sku gsum gyi zhing khams 'bul ba'i maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa thugs la btags

rang gzhung tshogs gnyis sbrin tshogs ltar/ mchan par zhu/ zhes brda sbyar la phul bcug / de nas gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ 'o na/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba med du mi rung ba dngos grub myur du 'thob byed ltar snang dang sgro skur gyi dbang gis ma yin par/ bla ma dang lam gyi gdams pa la the tshom med pa dwangs 'dod yid ches kyi dad pa rtsa bar bzung ste/ gnas dus ston 'khor tha mal rang rgyud pa min pa'i dag pa'i snang ba la ma rmongs pa zhig dang*/ thabs la mkhas pa'i cho ga rgyu gnyis rkyen bzhi yid la nges pa zhig yod des chog yin pas na/ rang re sdod pa'i sa phyogs sku gsum dag pa'i zhing ston 'khor dgongs pa tha mi dad pa'i go ba dang*/ khyad par bla ma ye shes dam pa'i rang gzugs rdo rje 'chang dngos yin snyam pa'i dad gus spro dga' snga na med pa dang bcas pa'i sgo nas pad+ma kha 'bus lta bu'i thal mo snying khar sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad par zhu/ e ma ho: skyes chen 'gro mgon sogs/ bla ma'i phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya slob mar bstan te/ gnang ba sbyin pa 'di la snyan gtod 'tshal/ zhes/ e ma skal ldan sogs/ de nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i khyad chos yin la de la'ang theg pa gong 'og so so'i lam gyi skyabs su 'gro tshul mang du yod na'ang*/ skabs su babs pa ni theg chen byang chub sems kyis kun nas bslang ste/ gsang mchog rdo rje theg pa'i rang lugs rdo rje phung po'i byed bcings la brten nas sbyod byed thabs khyad par can rtsa thig rlung gsum gnad du bsnun nas/ sbyang bya nyon mongs pa'i rlung lnga rnam par sbyangs shing sbyang*/ gzhi sku dang ye shes mngon du byas pa'i myur lam khyad par can gyis skyabs su 'gro ba yin pas yin tshul shes pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos gyis shig /rlung lnga

sogs/ lan gsum/ skal ldan rang gi sogs nas skyabs 'gro gyis shig bar/ 'o sems bskyed pa ni gang zag gi blo tshod dang bstun pa'i sems can la dmigs pa dang chos la dmigs pa dang dmigs med don gyi sems bskyed kyi bar gong 'phel la bslab dgos mod/ skabs su babs pa la sangs rgyas dang sems can rig ma rig gi khyad par las med pas/ rang re sems can gyi khams na sangs rgyas sku gsum rang chas su bzhugs pa yin kyang*/ kun gzhi lung ma bstan ma rig pa gsum dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i glo bur gyi dri mas bsgribs nas yod pa bla ma'i drin gyis thabs zam mos skad cig la shan phyes nas/ gzhi las 'phags pa'i don mdzub tshugs su ngo sprad pas/ bye brag phyed ma thag pa rig pa rang sangs su dag /rig pa ye shes kyi rang zhal mngon sum du mthong ste rtogs grol dus mnyam du 'gyur nges pas na/ de lta bu'i gdams pa thob par bya ste don mngon sum du rtogs par bgyid do snyam pa'i ngang nas rjes zlos gyis/ kye ma ho/ ma rig sogs/ lan gsum/ rang gi rig pa sogs nas/ bskyed pa'o/ / 'jug pa ni/ e ma ho/ sangs rgyas sogs nas/ bya'o// bar dbyings ka dag sogs nas/ sems skyed cig / bar brjod/ 'khor ba'i kun rtog ye shes lngas bsrung ba'i phyir tshon skud sna lnga rgyal ba rigs lngar dngos su dmigs shig / ces oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis srung skud gdags/ de nas dam tshig bsgrag pa ni/ las bum gyi chu dung zhal du blugs la rdo rje rtse mo thur bstan gyis nang mchod kyi bdud rtsi'i thigs pa lan gsum bsres shing*/ slar rdo rje rtse mo gyen du drang por bslangs nas/ 'o rigs kyi bu rnams spyir gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa la dbang gis rgyud smin dgos/ dbang gi srog dam tshig la gnas dgos pa yin/ de'ang phung 'tshengs gnyis ka'i rgyu shin tu khe nyen che bas sbyor ba dam la bzhag pa'i phyir dam tshig gi chu nan sbyin pa la dmigs 'dun 'di ltar gyis shig

/chu 'di ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi la rnam pa rdo rje sems dpa' 'od kyi rang bzhin yungs 'bru tsam du gyur nas mgrin pa'i lam brgyud de snying dbus dwangs ma mi shigs pa'i thig le dang dbyer med du 'dres pa'i mos pas btung bar zhu/ zhes brda sbyar la/ hūm̐/ 'di ni dam tshig sogs nas/ legs par srungs shig / bar brjod do/ / 'o na dbang gi gzhi dgod pa ye shes dbab pa'i slad du/ khyed rang rnams kyi rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung gis 'dug la/ lus gnad drang por bsrangs rlung gi rgyu ba kha sbyor du 'dzin/ sems lhod kyis klod la dmigs 'dun 'di ltar du gyis shig/khyed rang rnams kyi tha mal gyi phung po mi dmigs pa'i ngang las skad cig gis chos sku kun tu bzang po sku mdog mthing ka nam mkha' dwangs pa'i mdog ltar sngo ba/ zhabs skyil krung dang phyag mnyam bzhag gis rang 'od kyi yum kun tu bzang mo dkar mo 'khril ba/ snang stong chu zla ltar gsal ba'i lus dbus su rtsa gsum ka ba btsugs pa lta bu'i mar snar lte 'og rtsa gsum sbubs gcig tu song ba'i lte bar rtsa 'dabs drug cu rtsa bzhi/ snying gar rtsa 'dabs brgyad/ mgrin par rtsa 'dabs bcu drug /sbyi bor rtsa 'dabs sum cu rtsa gnyis rnams gdugs kyi rtsibs ma brgyangs pa lta bur gsal ba'i rtsa 'khor rnams so so'i dbus su kun bzang yab yum re re dang*/ rtsa 'dabs rnams su'ang sku dang rtsa yig thig le 'od kyi rang bzhin mer mer shig shig gis gang ba gsal dgos pas gzhan du ma g.yengs par rlung dmigs sems gsum gnad du dril la 'di ltar gsal thob cig /dang po lte ba'i rtsa 'dabs rnams kyi nang du ā li dal bus tshang bar brjod 'og ma rnams de'i 'gres/ mchan bcu drug dang*/ a ta li ha/ udha raṃ yaṃ ṇaṃ na dza ṭi sa kha ram̐ yam̐/ de bzhin du snying ga'i rtsa 'dabs rnams kyi nang du ā li/ bcu drug dang

so sor dal bus brjod/ mchan/ kha tsa ṭa ta pha ya swā hā/ ka gha bha dzha dang*/ de bzhin du mgrin pa'i rtsa yig ni kā li so gnyis dang dal bus brjod/ mchan/ ra rā li lī aṃ e a ā/ de bzhin du spyi bo'i rtsa yig ni kā li so gnyis dang*/ pha phā/ phi phī/ ma mā/ mi mī/ ba bā/ bi bī/ nya nyā/ nyi nyī/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsā/ tsha tshā/ ṭa ṭā/ ṭha ṭhā/ pa pā/ na/ de ltar sku dang thig le yig 'bru rnams so so gsal stong der 'dzin med pas rtsa gnas rnams khams kyi dri ma thams cad dag ste 'od rtsa rnams rab tu dwangs shing rang byung 'od gsal gyi snang ba mngon du byas byung bsam pa'i mos 'dun brtan po gyis shig / ces ḍā dril dang bcas dbyangs rab tu snyan pos/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /lte bar sprul pa'i= sogs brjod/ rgyas par spro na tshig mtshams so sor nas bcad de dmigs pa rim par phog pa dang*/ min kyang chab cig tu dmigs pa gal che/ dmigs pa ci bzhin ma zin kyang dad pa skyed cing nges shes bskyed do/ /de nas me tog dor ba ni/ 'o/ rang rang gi las 'brel gyi lha gang yin ngos 'dzin pa dang ma 'ongs pa na rigs gang du sangs rgyas pa'i rten 'brel brtags pas lha dang bla ma'i thugs rje'i mthus legs par bstan du gsol snyam pas re dogs med par/ mdun gyi rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor las gnyis pa zhig shar gyis byung bar mos la 'di'i rjes zlos dang bcas pas 'dor bar zhu/ zhes/ e ma ho/ thog ma'i sogs 'bab par shog / zhes dor la gang du bab pa de ma nor ba bla mas rim par brtags/ slob ma mang na ming gi rim pa gsal byed ltar bya'o/ / de nas mig dang dbye ba la 'dun pa 'di ltar gyis shig /ye gdod ma nas rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes gsum ldan dang 'bral ma myongs kyang*/ ma rig gsum gyi dri ma mig gi ling thog lta bus bsgribs pa de thugs rje'i thabs la mkhas pa'i slob dpon khyed kyis man ngag gser gyi thur ma lta bus bsal du gsol snyam pa kha tsam ma yin pa snying nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i blos 'di'i rjes zlos gyis shig

/kye ma rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs bsal du gsol/ / bla mas gser thur thogs te/ gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ e ma skal ldan sogs/ mtshon bar brjod/ 'o mig dar bsal ba dang chab cig ma rig pa sangs kyis bsal te/ mtshon byed rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas mtshon bya 'od gsal don gyi dkyil 'khor mngon sum du mthong bar mos shig / ces brda sbyar la/ mig ras gsal nas thur mas mig grib bcad tshul byas la/ de'i don yang sogs kyis spro ba bskyed do/ / de nas mthong ba bstan pa la bzhi yod pas dang po bla ma'i mthong ba bstan pa ni/ bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos dang chos rdzogs pa chen po la yid ches kyi dad pa brtan po gyis shig / ces brda sbyar la/ ltos shig sogs/ smos/ lan zhu/ gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi mthong ba bstan pa ni/ 'o na thun mong gi rgyud sde 'og ma'i dkyil 'khor mthong ba tsam gyis ma bsgoms kyang skye ba bdun nas sangs rgyas par gsungs na/ 'jig rten pa'i mtshan ma rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor la rten nas don dam rang byang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor skad cig gis mngon sum mthong nas rab lo zla tsam dang 'bring bar dor sgra 'od zer gsum rang snang du shes pa dang*/ tha ma yang dbang gi dam tshig ma nyams na rjes dran gsum gyi sgo nas rnam grol dbugs chen 'byin pa'i zhing lngar grol nges pas na u dum wā ra'i me tog las kyang ches cher dkon pas na dad pa dang nges shes bzang po gyis la legs par ltos shig /ces brda sbyar la/ bla mas phyag shing lta bus rim par ngo sprod pa'i tshul gyis tshig gsal la dag pas 'di ltar brjod/ / ltos shig mig can sogs dang*/ dbus su zlum po sogs tshig lhug gis ngo sprad do/ / gsum pa rdzas kyi mthong ba bstan pa ni gsang sngags phyi nang rdzas kyi khyad par gsungs ltar rten 'brel gyi dpe la brten nas don ngo shes par bya ba'i rten 'brel yin pas nges shes dang ldan pas legs par gsan 'tshal/

zhes brda sbyar la/ e ma brda shes sogs/ smros/ lan zhu/ kye skal ldan rigs kyi bu sogs nas/ brda'o/ / bar brjod/ bzhi pa mched lcam gyi mthong ba bstan pa la/ legs par snyan gtod 'tshal/ de la spyir rlung yid sems gsum gyis bsdus pa'i skye 'gro yod do cog la bde gshegs snying pos khyab cing*/ ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas su nges pas spyi'i mched dang*/ de las bye brag sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs so cog ston pa gcig pas ring ba'i mched dang*/ khyad par sngags rdo rje theg pa la zhugs pa thams cad theg pa gcig pas nye ba'i mched dang*/ yang dgos pha lta bu'i bla ma dang*/ ma lta bu'i dkyil 'khor gcig gis bsdus pa la zhugs snga phyi spun rgan gzhon lta bu dang*/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor dang mar me gcig la brten pa ni mtshe ma lta bu'i nang 'dres pa'i mched lcam du gsungs pas na/ da res nges gsang 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyu gnyis rkyen bzhi tshogs pa'i smin byed dbang dang*/ grol byed gdams pa man ngag car phog gis ngo sprad nas sku dang ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che lo zla tsam gyis tshom bu gcig tu tshogs pa gdon mi za bas na mched lcam gyi dam tshig mig 'bras ltar srung snyams pas dad pa dang dag snang bskyed 'tshal/ bla mas dri ba ni/ e ma ngo mtshar sogs/ mthong re ran/ zhes dang*/ thar pa bsgrub pa'i sogs/ lan zhu'o/ / de yan chod kyis 'jug pa'i chos kyi rim pa legs par grub pa lags/ zhugs nas mngon par dbang bskur ba la/ dang po spros bcas bum dbang gi slad du dmigs 'dun 'di ltar gyis shig / dbus kyi bum pa thogs te/ gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs nam mkha' gang ba dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon tha mi dad pa'i phyag na gzhom bral ka dag mtshon pa'i bum par lhun grub zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba g.yo ba'i tshul gyis bsnams nas/

bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du ma dang bcas nas dbang bskur ba'i nus pas sgo gsum cha mnyam dang bcas pa'i dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa gtor zhing dag /rang gnas rang byung gi ye shes gsum gyi bdag nyid blugs pa'i tshul gyis mngon du byas pa'i skal ba bzang po rgyud la bzhag pa'i nges shes skyed mdzod/ / ces brda sbyar la bum pa spyi bor bzhag/ oṃ/ chos nyid dbyings sogs/ de'ang dbyings chos nyid sogs skyed cig / bar ro/ shar bum thogs te/ 'o rigs kyi bu rnams rdo rje'i rigs kyi bum pas dbang bskur pas ma rigs pa kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi dri ma sangs kyis dag ste/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas pa'i nges shes skyed mdzod/ / snying gar gtugs la/ hūm̐ ma skyes sogs shes par gyis shig / bar ro/ /lho bum thogs te/ 'o rigs kyi bu rnams rin chen rigs kyi bum pas dbang bskur bas ma rig pa yid shes kyi dri ma sangs kyis dag ste/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas pa'i nges shes skyed mdzod/ / mgrin par gtugs te/ swā: rang byung ye shes sogs nas nges shes skyed cig / bar ro/ /nub bum thogs te/ 'o rigs kyi bu rnams pad+ma rigs kyi bum pas dbang bskur bas ma rig pa nyon yid kyi dri ma sangs kyis dag ste/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas pa'i nges shes skyed mdzod/ / lte bar gtugs la/ āḥ ma skyes sogs nas/ ngo shes par gyis shig / bar ro/ /byang bum thogs te/ 'o rigs kyi bu rnams las kyi rigs kyi bum pas dbang bskur bas sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa'i 'khrul rtog gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma sangs kyis dag ste/ sku dang ye shes lhun gyis grub pa bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes mngon sum du byas pa'i nges shes skyed mdzod/ / ces brda sbyar la/ hā: ye shes zang thal sogs nas/ dbang thob shog / skabs dang bstun te spyi bo sogs kyi rtsa yig brjod de gnas so sor bzhag la bum chu 'thor zhing*/

dbyangs gsal dang*/ spyi bo/ pha phā/ phi phī/ ma mā/ mi mī/ ba bā/ bi bī/ nya nyā/ nyi nyī/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsā/ tsha tshā/ ṭa ṭā/ ṭha ṭhā/ pa pā/ na/ mgrin pa/ ra rā/ li lī/ aṃ e/ a ā/ snying ga / kha tsa ṭa ta pha ya swāhā/ ka gha bha dz+nya/ lte ba/ a ta li ha/ u dha raṃ yaṃ ṇaṃ naṃ dza ṭi sa kha raṃ yaṃ ha he ho/ mthar khrus bya zhing bum chu ngag tu blud do/ / de yang rig pa'i ye shes sogs gyis shig / ces dang*/ de dag ni sogs/ dbang ngo*/ / bar ro/ / de ltar na de dag gis bum pa'i dbang gi rim pa legs par grub zin pa lags/ gnyis pa spros med gsang ba'i dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig /khyed rang rnams kun bzang yab yum gsal ba'i lus dbus su rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi'i rtsa 'dabs so so'i dbus su bde chen ye shes kyi rang 'od 'bar ba'i klong du kun bzang yab yum rjes chags kyi nyams can re bzhugs par mos/ bla ma yang kun bzang yab yum du gsal ba sbyor bas bde ba'i sgra dang 'od zer gyis bskul te zhing khams rab 'byams kyi rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad rigs lnga yab yum kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ rjes chags kyi mes bzhu bas bde chen byang chub sems kyi ngo bor gsang ba'i rdo rje nas brgyud yum gyi pad+mor lhung ba khams dkar dmar 'dres pa thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang dbyer med pa khyed rang rnams kyi lce thog tu phul ba mgrin par brgyud de 'khor lo bzhi'i rtsa gnas na bzhugs pa'i kun bzang yab yum gyi zhal du zhugs pas so sor rjes chags su sbyor ba'i byang sems dang gcig tu 'dres te/ rtsa 'dabs rnams su khyab pas dbyangs gsal dang rtsa yig so sos mer khrig ger gang bas lus kyi nang thams cad zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis bde chen ye shes kyi snang ba rab tu rgyas pa'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag pa'i nges shes skyed mdzod/ /

ces thod pa thogs la/ hūm̐/ bde chen sogs nas/ thob par shog: gnas so sor gtugs la dbyangs gsal dang*/ spyi bor/ pha phā/ phi phī/ ma mā/ mi mī/ ba bā/ bi bī/ nya nyā/ nyi nyī/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsā/ tsha tshā/ ṭa ṭā/ ṭha ṭhā/ pa pā/ na/ mgrin par/ ra rā/ li lī/ aṃ e/ a ā/ snying gar/ kha tsa ṭa ta pha ya swāhā/ ka gha bha dz+nya/ lte bar/ a ta li ha/ u dha raṃ yaṃ ṇaṃ na dza ṭi sa kha raṃ yaṃ/ ha he ho/ de ltar rtsa yig rnams gsal bzhin bdud rtsi btung bas ma dag pa'i rtsa thig rlung gsum dwangs ma'i rlung lngar gyur te sku dang ye shes kyi snang ba mngon du byas pa'i skal ba bzang po rgyud la bzhag pa'i nges shes dang bcas dal cig mnyam par zhog mdzod/ / ces dang*/ de yang rang byung gi sogs ngo shes par gyis shig / bar ro/ / des gsang ba'i dbang gi rim pa grub pa lags/ gsum pa shin tu spros med shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gyis shig /slob dpon kun bzang yab yum du gsal ba dang*/ khyod rang rnams kun tu bzang po yab rkyang re dmigs shig /slob dpon gyis rigs kyi yum gyi ngo bo'i rig ma gtad pas/ brda dang brda len gyi mtshams sbyar te/ 'du shes gsum gyi snyoms par zhugs pa'i mos 'dun gyis shig / ces rig tsakra gtad la/ hūm̐/ snang srid sogs nas grol bar nges so// zhes ba'i bar brjod do/ / des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur grub pa lags/ bzhi pa rab tu spros med tshig gi sgo nas don dam ngo sprod pa'i dbang la/ tshogs drug gi yul du dbang po rkyen khar shor ba'i g.yeng ba spangs te/ shes pa cung zad rang babs su bzhag pa'i ngang nas brda'i don 'di la legs par nyon la yid la zungs shig /ces brda don brjod pa ni/ kye/ skal ba dang ldan pa sogs nas gdod ma'i btsan sa zin pa'o/ / zhes pa'i bar ngag dag cing gsal bas/ tshig dal bus su brda sprad do/ / de nas dbyangs dang bcas pas/

e ma ho/ ma yengs gson cig nas/ ngo mtshar che'o/ /des tshig dbang rin po che'i dbang bskur grub pa lags/ zhes pa'i bar tshig bcad lhug rnams legs par brjod cing ngo sprod gzengs bstod pa dang*/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba sogs bya/ dpon slob kun gyis tshogs la rol zhing smon lam bzang po gdab/ dbang so so zhag gis chod pa'i dbang du byas na/ bla mas lhag ma gtong ba sogs cho ga'i mtha' bsdu zhing bkra shis bsngo smon bcas mtha' rgyas bya'o/ /des spros bcas thun mong dbang bzhi'i rim pa'i zin bris grub zin to// // ༈ dmigs med brtse bas gdul byar rjes chags kyis/ /gang 'dul theg rim mtha' yas 'jug sgo las/ /'od gsal rdzogs chen lam bzang snang mdzad pa'i/ /brgyud gsum ngo bo rdo rje bla mar 'dud/ /spros med dbang chog rin chen drwa ba la/ /'jug bder mtshams sbyor tho tsam spel ba la/ /lha dang bla mas gnang ba'i skabs dbye ste/ /rnam kun shis pa'i snang ba bskyed du gsol/ /de la 'dir bla ma yang tig yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang bskur gnyis pa thun min spros med kyi dbang la sbyor ba dkyil 'khor rgyan bkod sogs rang gzhung ltar legs par 'du bya/ cho ga spros bcas bum dbang gi skabs ji skad bshad pa ltar/ bdag bskyed skabs bzlas pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phral te/ oṃ yid bzlas gtsor 'don gyis stong phrag ma mtha'/ āḥhūm̐/ gnyis kyang de mtshungs/ dbyangs gsal kyang de lhag tsam bzla ba'i khyad par ro/ /de nas bum pa la dmigs te/ chos nyid ka dag stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi bum pa rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i tshad dang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sman spos 'o mas sum cha man chad gang ba'i chu'i rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i skye med kyi yi ge a dkar pos shig shig gang bar mos/ zhes gsal la/ a/ kho na yid bzlas gtso bor byas te brgya stong khri sogs skabs bstun dang*/

dbyangs gsal kyang stong phrag ma mtha' byas pa ci 'grub bzla'o/ /smin dbang tshad ldan gyi dbang du byas na/ gzhung nas ji skad bshad pa ltar bzlas pa grangs tshang bar mdzad na shin tu legs mod/ gang ltar a yig dang bum chu dbyer med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi myang reg tsam gyis grol ba'i nus ldan du dmigs so/ /las bum sngar spros bcas skabs bsgrubs zin pa de la lha sngags dmigs pa'i kha gso bya/ /dbang so so zhag gis ma chod pa'i dbang du na/ tshogs mchod rkyang pa byas nas lhag ma'i mgor dbang bskur/ de nas slob ma phyi rol nas khrus bya ba sogs spros bcas skabs ltar grub nas/ bla mas/ 'o khyed rnams la 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i dbang gnyis pa thun min spros med kyi dbang rin po che'i drwa ba bskur ba'i skabs su bab pa yin/ de la bla ma dang slob ma'i bya ba gnyis yod pas/ bdag gis bgyi 'os rnams legs par grub zin/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal bla ma skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gsal ba'i drung du sku gsum zhing khams rgya mtsho'i bkod pa blos blangs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ maṇ+ḍal rgyas bsdus gang rung 'bul bcug la/ kun slong bcos pa ni/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad gdod ma'i mgon po'i go 'phang la bdag gcig pus dgod par bya/ de'i ched du nges gsang 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i smon byed dbang bskur gyi rim pa legs par gsan la grol byed lam gyi rim pa gdams ngag tu dril nas dad brtson brtul zhugs dang ldan pa'i sgo nas lhur len cing*/ 'bras bu yid smon ma yin par lo zla tsam gyis dag pa gnyis ldan don gnyis lhun grub kyi rgyal sar dbang 'byor ba zhig ci nas kyang bya snyam pa'i dam bca' brtan pos kun slong bcos pa dang*/ kun spyod kyi rim pa'ang dran shes bag yod dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gsal btab la legs par gsan 'tshal/

shin tu rnyed pa dka' ba sogs rang gzhung ltar/ mchog tu bde ba'o/ / bar dang*/ de la'ang gdul bya sems can gyi khams dang dbang po bsam pa'i khyad par dang mthun pa'i chos kyi sgo mo ji snyed cig gsungs pa thams cad mdor bsdu na/ rgyu lam byed dang 'bras bu lam du byed pa'i khyad par gyis mdo sngags gnyis su grags pa las/ 'di ni 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa yin/ de yang rigs dang dus kyi khyad par la dgongs ste rgyud sde bzhir gsungs pa'i nang nas/ 'di rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sder gtog la/ de la'ang snga 'gyur nang rgyud sde gsum gyi nang tshan rdzogs pa chen po la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs srol gang zag dbang rnon dang*/ dbang po yang rab gnyis kyi khyad par las/ snga ma ltar na snang ba yul gyi blo can rim gyis lam du bkri ba'i phyir/ rgyud lung man ngag gsum zhes gzhi lam 'bras bu'i tshul du nang rgyud yo ga gsum du grags pa las/ 'di ni shin tu rnal 'byor man ngag a ti yo ga'o/ /de'ang rigs can gsum la dgongs pa'i sems klong man ngag gsum gyi nang nas man ngag gi sde yin/ de la'ang phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang bla na med pa'i skor tsho bzhi bzhugs pa gang nyams su blangs na gang zag gcig gi lam gyi cha rkyen kha tshangs/ gdams pa gzhan la rag ma lus pa yin la/ 'di ni kun gyi bcud 'dril lta bu bla ma yang tig yid bzhin nor bu zhes chos sde sum cu rtsa lnga'i bdag nyid can/ gdams ngag chings su bcings shing 'gags bsdoms pa yang gsang bla med 'od gsal 'pho ba chen po'i lam bzang*/ shin tu dbang rnon rig pa rang snang gi blo can 'phrad pa tsam gyis sa lam chig chod rtogs grol dus mnyam spangs blangs rtsol sgrub la ma ltos par byar med ye rdzogs chen po'i klong du 'tshang rgya ba dang*/ min kyang gdams pa dang bla ma ya bral du ma song ba'i dad gus dang ldan pa'i rigs can rnams dad pa'i nyer len gyis rtogs pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes te lo zla tsam mam/

bar do las mi 'gyang bar 'tshang rgya ba'i man ngag zab mo 'di'i spros med dbang bskur gyi skabs su bab pa yin la/ rdo rje theg pa'i dngos grub kyi skal ba che chung dad pa dang dam tshig la rag las pas 'dun pa 'di ltar gyis shig /rang re sdod pa'i sa phyogs 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang*/ rdo rje slob dpon nyid chos sku kun bzang 'od mi 'gyur ba dang*/ longs sku rdo rje 'chang*/ sprul sku rig 'dzin brgyud pa so so ma yin tha mi dad pa rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag nyid chen po dngos yin snyam pa dang*/ khyed rang rdo rje'i mched lcam rnams kyang rgyu rdo rje bzhi'i bdag nyid can dang*/ thabs zab mo smon grol gyi gdams pa dang 'phrad pas srid pa tha ma'i rig 'dzin yin pa la yin tshul shes pas tshig gi rjes su don yid la dran bzhin gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum re gnang bar zhu/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs nas bsil bar mdzod/ / lan gsum dang*/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs nas mdzad du gsol/ / bar lan gsum bya'o/ / de'ang lam gyi srog dam tshig la gnas dgos pas bsrung bya rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba dang*/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig dgu gsum nyer bdun las mi 'da' bar bsrung dgos/ srung tshul kyang phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang ye srung rgyal po'i lugs sogs lta spyod zung 'jug gis ngo bo gnas 'gyur yon tan yar ldan gyi tshul gyis dus su bab pa'i spyod pa gtso bor 'don pas de ltar bgyid do snyams pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pas phyag rgya snying khar sbyar te 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gnang bar zhu/ sdom pa bzung ba ni/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams dgongs su gsol/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sogs nas mi 'da'o/ / zhes pa'i bar brjod/ slar dam chu sbyin pa ni/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi 'di nyon mongs pa'i bdud la ye shes kyi rtsis thebs pa'i rten 'brel yin pas dam tshig la tshul bzhin gnas na rdo rje sems dpar gyur te 'di phyi'i phan bde ma lus stsol med du 'grub cing*/

nyams na khro bor gyur te tshe 'dir mi 'dod pa du mas mnar zhing*/ phyi ma na rag chen por ltung bas na khai nyen shin tu che ba'i tha tshig la gnas par gyis shig /ces/ hūm̐/ 'di ni dam tshig sogs thub par gyis/ / ces brjod cing dam chu sbyin no/ / de lta bu'i dam tshig spyi dang khyad par mi nyams par bsrung ba khas blangs pa 'di'i rjes zlog lan gsum gnang bar zhu/ bdag gi dus 'di sogs nas/ 'das pa'i bya ba btang re kan/ / zhes pa'i bar brjod/ bla mas rdo rje gdengs te/ 'o/ rdo rje slob dpon dka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas rdo rjes dam la bzhag pa 'di nyid tshig tsam min pas snying nas dam bca' dgos pas legs par snyan gtod 'tshal/ dam bsgrag pa ni/ kye/ skal ldan sems kyi bu sogs nas ma gtong zhig / bar lan gsum brjod de slob bu'i gnas gsum du rdo rje bzhag go / des sbyor ba'i chos kyi rim pa dam la bzhag pa dang bcas grub pa lags/ de nas don kyi dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa dngos gzhi'i dbang rnams rim par 'byung bas/ de la gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ maṇ+ḍal phul ba sngon du 'gro dgos pas sku gsum gyi zhing khams rgyas bsdus gang mtshams/ mchan/ 'bul bar zhu/ zhes maṇ+ḍal 'bul bcug /me tog gtad la/ 'o/ rigs nges pa'i phyir rdo rje thal mos me tog snying khar zung la mos pa'i dad pa khyad par can gyis kun nas bslang ste 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ de'i lam las phyir mi ldog pa dam bca' bzung ba'i ched du 'di'i rjes zlog lan gsum/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin sogs/ slar yang ldog par mi bgyid do/ / bar brjod/ bla mas rdo rje dang bcas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya slob mar bstan te/ 'o/ de ltar dam tshig spyi dang bye brag la gnas shing bla ma dang gdams ngag la gcig tu gus pa ni skal ldan gyi rigs su nges pas na rjes su gnang ba 'di la snyan gtod 'tshal/

zhes/ e ma bu khyod sogs nas/ slar ma ldog / ces brjod la/ de nas 'jug pa thun mong ma yin pa ni/ khyed rang rnams rang rang gi gral las bzhengs te rkang pa'i long bu gnyis gshibs/ lag gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyor mig btsums la dmigs pa 'di ltar gyis shig / bla mas drag sngags brjod cing yungs dkar thun gyis brab/ gu gul bdug cing khro bo'i rgyal po'i nga rgyal gyis bgegs bskrad la dmigs pa 'di ltar du phog/ khyed rang rnams kyi phung khams skye mched kyis mtshon snod bcud ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad dbyings su thim/ stong pa rig pa'i snying po can gyi rang rtsal 'gags med kyi rol par snod dag pa 'og min bde chen 'bar ba'i pho brang*/ bcud dag pa snang srid lha'i phyag rgyar bsgrub pa'i slad du/ pad zla nyi ma'i gdan la bcom ldan 'das khros ma dmar mo zhabs gnyis dor thabs/ phyag g.yas zangs kyi gri khug nam mkhar 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas thod par rak+tas bkang ba thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ thod skam kyi dbu rgyan dang thod rlon gyi do shal dar dang rin po che rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol ba/ rna ltag g.yas su phag zhal gyis mtshan pa snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa ye shes kyi rang 'od 'khrigs pa'i dbus na rol ba/ de'i snying dbus su 'od kha dog lnga ldan gyi g.yung drung dga' ba 'khyil ba g.yon du kyi li li 'khor bar dmigs/ nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad chos sku kun tu bzang po nas da ltar rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du byon pa'i 'od gsal rdzogs chen gyi dgongs brda snyan brgyud kyi bla ma rig 'dzin yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad sku gar stabs shig shig /gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis hūm̐ phaṭa kyi sgra seng seng*/ thugs zag med bde ba chen po'i rol gar 'ja' 'od thig le mer mer yom yom dang bcas nam mkha' bar snang thams cad sku yig phyag rgya'i rnam pas gang ba rnams mtsho chen po la kha ba babs pa ltar khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum dang dbang po'i sgo ba spu'i bu ga rnams su sib sib thim pa'i mos 'dun drag po gyis shig

/ ces brda sprad la zur gsal ltar/ e ma bu rnams dad gus sogs nas sgoms shig / bar brjod la ḍā dril dal bus bkrol zhing mtshams su bcad la/ oṃ gu ru kun tu bzang po sa ma yā dza dza: oṃ gu ru rdo rje sems dpa' swa ma yā dza dza: oṃ gu ru dga' rab rdo rje sa ma yā dza dza: oṃ gu ru māñdzu shrī sa ma yā dza dza: oṃ gu ru shrī sidha sa ma yā dza dza: oṃ gu ru dz+nyā na sū tra sa ma yā dza dza: oṃ gu ru bi ma mi tra sa ma yā dza dza: oṃ gu ru ting 'dzin bzang po sa ma yā dza dza: oṃ gu ru ldang ma lhun rgyal sa ma yā dza dza: oṃ gu ru seng ge dbang phyug sa ma yā dza dza: oṃ gu ru zhang ston pa sa ma yā dza dza: oṃ gu ru mkhas pa nyi 'bum sa ma yā dza dza: oṃ gu ru jo 'ber sa ma yā dza dza: oṃ gu ru sangs rgyas dbon sa mā ya dza dza: oṃ gu ru me long rdo rje sa ma yā dza dza: oṃ gu ru ku mā rā dza sa ma yā dza dza: oṃ gu ru klong chen rab 'byams sa ma yā dza dza: oṃ gu ru brgyud gsum kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma sa ma yā dza dza: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho: ā be sha ya a be sha ya a āḥ

brjod cing rol mo drag tu sgrogs so/ / khyad par rgya nag= sogs nas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa: bar brjod cing byin dbab bo/ / rig pa'i me tog dor ba la thun mong dang khyad par gnyis las/ 'dir thun mong ba mtshan bcas kyi me tog bla ma'i phyag tu phul ba'i brda thabs kyi rten 'brel gyis khyad par ba rang byung rig pa'i ye shes 'od gsal ma'i tha snyad bla ma'i thugs dang dbyer med pa sgrib pa dang bral ba de rig pa'i me tog dor ba'i gzhir byas la/ slob ma'i rgyud kyi 'od gsal bu'i tha snyad ye don kyi kun gzhi rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi dri mas bsgrigs pa de nyid dor ba'i tshul du byas pas dbyer med ro gcig 'khor gsum mtshan ma dang bral ba de don gyi rig pa'i me tog gam/ brda phyag 'tshal ba zhes grags pas na thugs 'dun 'di ltar gyis shig / ces/ thugs kyi dkyil 'khor sogs nas/ zhes bya'o/ / bar brjod/ des dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i rim pa thun mong ma yin pa grub zin pa lags/ don gnyis pa dbang bskur ba dngos la sogs nas/ aṃ āḥ bar brjod/ de nas skye mched byin gyis brlab pa rnams rim par gzhung ltar grub pa dang*/ spro na tshogs dang gtor ma 'bul ba sogs rjes kyi bya ba rnams kyang mtha' rgyas su bya'o/ /des thun min spros med dbang gi rim pa'i zin tho grub pa yin no// // ༈ gnyis snang 'khrul pa chos kyi dbyings su zad/ /ji ltar ji snyed 'od gsal mngon du byas/ /nges gsang bstan pa'i shing rta nyi ma'i gnyen/ / kun mkhyen rje dang dbyer med bla mar 'dud/ /de la 'dir bla ma yang tig yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang gsum pa shin tu spros med dbang gi zin tho la/ khyad par gyi sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur tshul lo/ /dang po tshogs kyi yo byad dang*/ slob ma la bskur rgyu'i dkar dmar gtor ma sogs la 'du bya/ de nas rang gzhung ltar tshogs mchod rgyas par byas nas lhag ma'i mgor bzhag

/las bum gyi khro bo slar gsal btab ste 'khyil sngags ci mang dang*/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs ring thung ci mang gis nus ldan du bsgrub/ mchod bstod nongs bshags rgyas bsdus skabs bstun bya/ lha 'od du zhu ba'i chu'i rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i lha dang bdud rtsi dbyer med du gyur nas phyi nang gsang ba'i sdig sgrib sbyangs pa dang*/ bar chad bsrung ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par mos/ de nas slob ma rnams la phyi rol du khrus dang nye reg byas nas bla ma'i drung du 'khod pa la/ kun slong gcos shing chos gshad ci rigs pas mtshams sbyar/ skabs su bab pa ni rang lugs shin tu spros med kyi dbang la sngon 'gro sta gon gyi rim pa dang*/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba gnyis su 'byung ba las/ 'di ni sta gon gyi rim pa yin/ de'ang thun mong gi lugs la dbang bzhi so so'i snod rung du bya ba dang*/ legs nyes kyi mtshan ma brtag pa'i phyir rten 'brel rdzas la brten nas sta gon du gnas par bya ba yin kyang*/ 'dir ni gzung bya 'khor 'das sogs la 'dzin byed re dogs gnyis la ru zhes bzhed la de thun mong ma yin pa'i thabs kyi spyod pa zab mo bltul zhugs lam khyer gyis gnyis chos spang blang re dogs las 'das pa'i lam du lhong ba'i don la shan phye zhes gsungs pas na 'khor 'das ru shan phye ba zhes grags pa lags/ de la'ang rgyud kyi dgongs pa bka' gter so sor srol mi 'dra ba mang du bzhugs kyang*/ 'di ni sgo gsum chun gcig tu byas nas gnyis snang re dogs kyi 'phrang las sgrol te/ gnyis med thig le nyag gcig gzhon nu bum skur grol ba'i rten 'brel sta gon du bya ba yin pas/ brgyud gsum skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i ngo bo bla ma yin pa'i nges shes dang bcas bar chad zhi zhing byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa'i phyir bsags sbyong gi rten gsol ba gdab pa'i yul tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa sogs mnyam du gsung bar zhu/

zhes brda sbyar la/ hūm̐ hrī: sngon gyi bskal ba'i dang po sogs/ gnas mchog 'di ru= oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /bdag gi spyi bo sogs dang rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ / sogs yan lag brgyad pa'i tshogs bsags sngon du 'gro bas/ slar mos gus gdung shugs drag pos gsol 'debs bdud rtsi'i sprin tshogs ltar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gdod ma'i mgon po sogs nas/ spro na brgyud pa'i kha skong bcas dang*/ nye brgyud gang rung dang*/ gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sogs nas tshe 'di nyid la phyin par mdzad du gsol/ / zhes dbyangs dang bcas pas legs par brjod/ maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa tshogs gnyis sprin tshogs ltar 'bul/ de nas slob ma rnams gcer bu ang raka gyon pa'am/ min kyang stod g.yogs bsal nas bla ma'i drung du slob mas 'dud rgya bya/ rnam par shes pa tshogs brgyad gnas su dag pa dang*/ bar chad zhi bar bya ba'i phyir du go bgo ba ni/ khyed rang rnams kyis dmigs 'dun 'di ltar du gyis shig /slob dpon che mchog he ru ka sku mdog sngo nag rab tu 'jigs shing skra gyen du brdze ba/ mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'gyur ba khro bo'i chas dang ldan par gsal ba dang*/ khyed rang rnams kyang de ltar du bsgom pa'i spyi bor lam̐ ser po/ dpral bar e mthing ka /lkog mar su ser po/ mgrin par kham̐ dud kha/ nu ma gnyis la ha dkar po/ lte bar raṃ dmar po/ rkang mthil gnyis su yam̐ ljang gu ste yig 'bru rnams gsal la dwangs pa snang la rang bzhin med pa re gsal thob/ slar bla ma kun bzang che mchog he ru ka mngon sum pa yin snyams pa'i mos gus drag tu skyed cig / bla mas gzhi'i he ru ka'i nga rgyal la gnas pa'i ngang nas hūm̐ zhes/ drag tu brjod pas thugs ka nas thugs rje hūm̐ yig sngon po'i rnam pa dpag tu med pa 'phros te khyed rang rnams kyi snying nang du zhugs pas hūm̐ sngon po'i rnam par gyur par sgoms shig

/ ces bla mas hūm̐ 'jam la ring ba mang du brjod mthar/ ha ha/ zhes ngar dang bcas pas lan gsum brjod/ bla slob kun gyis tshogs la rol zhing*/ bsam pa lhun grub sogs smon lam khyad par can rnams dang bkra shis bsngo ba bcas grub 'phral/ slob ma gtso bo'i lag tu dkar dmar gyi gtor ma gtad de rang gnas su gtang ngo*/ /de nas mi yi rgyu 'grul dang mthong thos med pa'i sar phyin la/ yul de'i gzhi bdag dang mkha' 'gro la gtor ma dkar dmar sogs brngan cha ci 'byor bshams/ kun slong bzang pos skyabs sems sogs/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dbang bzhi bcas legs par grub 'phral/ gtor ma rgyas bsdus ci ltar rigs pas bsngo zhing*/ bar chad zhi zhing sdong grogs byed pa'i 'phrin las bcol bka' bsgo nan tan du bya'o/ /de nas sbyod pa dngos la rten 'brel gyi dgos ched gcer bu ang raka gam smad dkris byas la/ rang gzhung nas ḍā ma ru bkrol zhing kha ṭ+wām̐ thogs pa sogs gsungs kyang*/ gang ltar/ yul ri 'di'i gzhi'i bdag po dang bcas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad so so'i las snang gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi 'khrul pa'i sdug bsngal dang bral te/ rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che la myur tu dgod par bya ba'i ched du bdag gis sgo gsum re dogs kyi zhen 'dzin gcad par bya ba'i ched du bde sdug 'khor 'das thabs kyi spyod pa zab mos ru shan bgyid do/ / zhes ngag tu brjod cing yid la dung nger dran par byas te/ dbang gzhung nas ji skad bstan bzhin ngan song gsum dang*/ bde 'gro mtho ris gsum sogs 'khor ba'i rtog tshogs yid la gang dran res 'jog ma yin pas btsan thabs su bslangs te/ de'i lus kyi rnam 'gyur/ ngag gi sgra skad sogs smyon pa khro langs pa lta bu'i spyod pa sgo gsum gcig dril gyi sgo nas sdig pa'i rgyu 'bras sna tshogs kyi dogs pa gang dran dang*/

dge ba'i rgyu 'bras kyi re ba gang dran spyod pas ngal dub kyis thang chad chad par bya zhing*/ mtshan mo smra brjod sogs gang yang mi bya bar bag yangs su nyal bar bya'o/ /skabs su sems kyi ru shan kho na dang*/ lus dang ngag kyang de ltar so sor chun gcig tu bya ba sogs rang rgyud la gang phan nyams su len/ rab tu shan 'byed pa'i rtags ma thon bar/ 'bring zhag nyer gcig/tha na'ang bdun gcig zhag gsum sogs la 'bad pa bskyed 'tshal/ de ltar spyod pa'i phan yon ni gzhung nas ci skad bshad pa ltar 'byongs pa la the tshom med pas gal che'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la'ang sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ maṇ+ḍal la dri bzang byug cing*/ steng du tsakli'am mar tshon gyis mu khyud dang*/ 'od lnga'i ra ba zlum skor spros pa dang bstun/ me tog gi tshom bu lnga sogs rang gzhung ltar bya/ gnyis pa nam langs dus slob mas dri bzang dam bdud rtsi can gyi shing dang*/ mkhan pa dkar po dang*/ 'om bu'i khu bas rang lus mgo mjug thams cad legs par bkrus shing*/ nyi ma rtse shar la lag stong min pas phyag rten maṇ+ḍal 'byor tshad dam/ me tog sogs thogs te bla ma'i sgo drung du 'dus la/ las slob kyis khrus nas dbyungs 'phral bla ma'i drung du stod g.yogs phud nas thal mo snying khar sbyar la dga' ba'i mdangs dang bcas te 'khod do/ /bla mas/ bu khyod su yin= sogs nas gzhung ltar lnga tshan lnga'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba rnams bya'o/ /de nas spros med kyi byin rlabs dbab pa'i ched du/ khyed rang rnams rang rang gi gdan las langs te stod g.yogs phud nas thal mo snying khar sbyor/ rkang pa'i long bu gnyis gshibs nas bla ma gzhi'i kun tu bzang po'am rdo rje sems dpa' dngos yin snyams pa'i nges shes bskyed la rtog pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par rlung mig sems gsum gcig dril gyis bla ma'i thugs kar ma yengs par gtod cig

/ces bla mas dgongs pa mi g.yo ba'i ngang nas phyag skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya slob ma so so la gtod pa'i tshul gyis a drug brtsegs drag la thung bar brjod pas/ slob ma'i lus 'phar ba dang*/ ngag gsal zhing smra ba/ sems mi rtog pa shar ba ni ye shes pa dbab pa yin no/ /de nas dngos gzhi don dam thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du gzhugs pa ni/ sems kyi mtshangs btsal ba byung gnas 'gro gsum mkhan po dang bcas pa'i rtsad bcad nas sems kyi khang bu gshig par bya ba'i phyir legs par snyan gtod la don yid la nges par gyis shig / ces brda sbyar la/ bla mas rdo rje dang bcas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya phyogs so sor rim par gtad bzhin tshig dag cing snyan pas dal bus su/ slob ma khyed rang rnams lus gnad de nyid kyis kha shar gyi nam mkhar gtod cig byas la/ e ma skal ldan shar phyogs kyi nam mkha'i dkyil la 'phar gam gam song dang*/ zhes lan gsum brjod de dar gcig bzhag la/ yang 'gro na 'gro sa 'dug gam/ /'gro ba'i mkhan po 'dug gam/ / zhes brjod cing*/ slob mas kyang legs par mtshangs btsal/ de bzhin du phyogs gzhan gsum la'ang de ltar bya zhing dris te/ mthar 'gro 'ong bsam mkhan dang bcas har seng du rtogs na des chog /min kyang byung gnas 'gro gsum bsgom rung gi nus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin pas don go bar gyis/ de'i don brda'i sgo nas ston pa yin pas 'di ltar nges par gyis shig / gzhung ltar bla mas phyag mdzub nam mkha'i dbyings su bsgrengs la yug yug lan gsum byas te/ nam mkha'i dbyings la ltos shig / ces lan gsum brjod do/ / chos sku mkha' mnyam dag ba'i dkyil 'khor bstan pa'o/ / sogs dbang gzhung ltar gzengs bstod pa yan song nas/ des gzhi lam gyi snang ba ngo sprad pa'am lam bsgom rung gi nus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ / zhes brjod do/ /mthar khas len dang gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal sogs spyi ltar shes par bya zhing*/

spro zhing long skabs dang bstun pa'i tshogs dang*/ bka' srung gsol mchod sogs mthar rgyas su grub par bya'o/ /des shin tu spros med kyi dbang gi zin tho grub zin pa lags/ / ༈ gzhi la lam gyis mtshams sbyar te/ /'bras bu mngon byas thabs mang kyang*/ /kun las khyad 'phags nges gsang don/ /ston mdzad rdo rje'i bla mar 'dud/ /de la 'dir bzhi pa rab tu spros med kyi dbang chog 'od kyi drwa ba zhes brda thabs khyad par can gyi sgo nas gzhi snang car phog tu ngo sprod cing*/ gzhi lam zung 'jug gi ye shes 'bras bu thob rung gi nus pa rgyud la 'jog par byed pa 'di la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po bsham bkod kyi rim pa gzhung ltar dang*/ bla ma'i zhal shar phyogs su gzigs pa sogs so/ /gnyis pa skabs su bab pa'i tshe slob ma yi ge brgya pas khrus nas phyung ste/ bla ma'i zhal la gdong phyogs nas 'dug ste/ lnga tshan lnga'i maṇ+ḍal dbul/ bla mas maṇ+ḍal gyi phan yon/ maṇ+ḍal lnga tshan rnams sogs nas/ spyod pa'o/ /bar brjod do/ / 'o/ don dam nges pa'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug par 'dod pa khyed rnams chos brgyad kyi bsam pa can dang*/ nyan rang gi rigs can lam 'dir 'jug pa'i skal ba med pas gdams ngag thabs kyis rku ba'i bsam pa spangs nas bla ma dang lam rdzogs pa chen po la phyir mi ldog pa'i dad brtson btul zhugs ldan pa'i gang zag gi chos skal yin pas rang rgyud la legs par brtags shing dri ba 'di la nges par gyis shig / ces bla mas/ bu khyod su yin= sogs dri ba dang lan gsol/ gnang ba sbyin pa sogs nas/ zhugs shig / bar brjod/ de nas dngos gzhi'i dbang la/ 'o/ rigs kyi bu rnams nyon cig /de la mthar thug don gyi dbang bskur ba la bdag gzhan 'khor ba las bsgral bar 'dod pa'i nges 'byung khyad par can dang*/ gdams pa dang bla ma ya ma bral ba'i dad pa khyad par can med na chos rdzogs pa chen po yin kyang gang zag nges pa med pas rgyud legs par 'chos la/

gzhi gtan la 'bebs pa ka dag khregs chod dang*/ lam lhun grub thod rgal gnyis kyi lam bsgom rung dang*/ nus pa thob rung gi skal ba rgyud la 'jog pa yin pas dad gus mos pa brtan pos gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gnang bar zhu/ zhes brda sbyar la/ kye kye/ bla ma sogs nas/ bstan du gsol/ / zhes pa'i bar gyis gsol ba gdab la/ sems nyid kyi rang bzhin bstan pa'i dbang dngos la khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum rang babs su lhod la bla ma'i thugs kar mig cer re gtod cig / ces bla mas drag shul gyi ngar dang bcas pas/ sems gang yin/ zhes lan gsum brjod pa sogs gzhung ltar ro// dang po sprul sku'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'i dbang la/ rten 'brel lus la bsgrigs na rtogs pa sems la 'char zhes pa ltar man ngag snying thig gi dgongs pa'i mthil/ lta lugs sogs phal cher dang mthun yang*/ blta tshul kun las khyad par du 'phags pa rang lugs la rtsa 'khor lo lnga'i 'od rtsa dwangs par byed pa'i thabs lta stangs dang*/ bzhugs stangs gzigs stangs gnad du bsnun dgos te dper na sbrul gyi rkang lag rang bzhin gyis mi mngon kyang*/ lus po gcur tshe mngon pa sogs kyi dpes/ don nyams su len pa la thabs 'di dag gal che bas lam gyi yan lag tu med mi rung ba yin pas/ dang po chos sku'i bzhugs stangs seng ge'i 'dug tshul lta bu 'di la dbye ba mang yang rang lugs 'dir rkang mthil gnyis sa la phab/ lus kyi cha bsrangs mgo bo'i rtsal mjings pa la bskur/ lag sor gnyis bsgongs te dpyi mig gnyis kyi thad nas sar btsug pa dang*/ yang rkang mthil gnyis mdun du sprad pa'i lang mo gnyis kyi nang thad drang por lag sor gnyis btsugs pa ste phyogs gnyis nyams len skabs rang khams dang bstun la/ mthar glang po'i sta stangs zhes pa ni mig thad drang du blta ba dang*/ seng ge'i mchongs stabs zhes mig gyen la ltog ste lag pa gnyis snying gi thad gdengs shing mchongs stabs byas te rig pa 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du skar mda' ltar 'phangs te phyir mi ldog pa'i nges shes dang bcas pas chos nyid skye ba med par ngang du zhog cig

/ ces brda sbyar la/ bla mas gsung gsal ngag snyan pas phyag skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya shar phyogs kyi nam mkha' la gtad de 'di ltar brjod do/ / e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu= sogs nas/ de kho na nyid ston to/ /bu khyod der glang po che'i lta stangs kyis ltos la seng ge'i mchongs stabs kyis mchongs shig / a a āḥ zhes sku gsum las phyir mi ldog pa'i rgyas gdab bo/ / yang slob ma'i kha lhor blta bcug la/ yang longs sku'i bzhugs stangs glang po che lta bu ni kha sbub la pus mo gnyis brang la sbyar*/ gru mo gnyis sa la btsugs te thal mo gnyis kyis mgrin pa yid tsam bteg /rkang pa'i sor mo phyir phul te bskums/ mig thad drang du blta/ mthar seng ge'i lta stangs zhes pa ni mig gyen du ldog / stag mo'i mchongs stabs ni mig 'phred la blta zhing sked pa nyed nyed byas te/ rig pa 'od kyi gong bu lho phyogs dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing du skar mda' ltar 'phangs te phyir mi ldog pa'i nges shes gyis la chos nyid skye ba med pa'i ngang du zhog cig / ces brda sprod pa/ gong ltar/ e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu khyod nyon cig /lho phyogs sogs nas/ stag mo'i chongs stabs kyis mchongs shig /a a āḥ zhes phyir mi ldog pa'i rgyas gdab bo/ /yang slob ma'i kha nub tu blta bcug la/ yang sprul sku'i bzhugs stangs drang srong lta bu ni lus tsog pur rkang mthil gnyis sa la phab/ pus mo gnyis brang la sbyar/ rgal tshigs drang por bsrangs/ rgyu ma yid tsam gyen la 'then nas rgal pa la bcar/ lag pa gnyis re'u mig thur du bsnol nas pus mos bkab na tsha ba'i nad sel/ gal te bsnol nas mchan khung gnyis su reg na grang ba'i nad sel/ gru mo gnyis pus mo gnyis kyi steng du bslangs te thal mo bsgongs nas lkog ma bteg na tsha grang snyam pa'i dgos pa yod pas de ltar dang*/ mthar dpal chen rngams stabs kyis zhes pa ni mig g.yon bzur nas khad kyis thad drang du blta ba dang*/

khyung nam mkha' lding ba'i 'gros stabs ni mig gyen du cung zad zlog ste/ rig pa 'od kyi gong bu nub phyogs pad+ma brtsegs pa'i zhing khams su skar mda' ltar 'phangs te phyir mi ldog pa'i nges shes gyis la chos nyid skye ba med pa'i ngang la zhog cig / ces brda sprad la/ gong ltar/ e ma/ skal ldan sems kyi bu khyod nyon cig /nub phyogs sogs nas/ song zhig /a a āḥ zhes phyir mi ldog pa'i rgyas gdab bo/ /yang slob ma'i kha byang du blta bcug la/ yang yan lag gi 'dug stangs bya rgod spungs pa lta bu ni rkang pa'i mthil gnyis sa la phab/ gtsos po sa la ma reg pas lus po ran tsam rgur/ lag pa gnyis thal mo gtsos po'i steng du bsnol/ mig gyen du bzlog ste zhing khams yid la bya/ mthar rdo rje 'chang gi lta stangs zhes lag gnyis khu tshur snying gar bsnol ba dang phyir 'phangs pa la glog dmar 'khyugs stangs bya ba yin pas rig pa 'od kyi gong bu skar mda' ltar byang phyogs las rab rdzogs pa'i zhing du 'phangs te phyir mi ldog pa'i nges shes gyis la chos nyid skye ba med pa'i ngang du zhog cig / ces brda sprad la gong ltar/ e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu khyod nyon cig /'di nas byang phyogs= sogs nas song zhig /a a āḥ zhes phyir mi ldog pa'i rgyas gdab bo/ /de dag ni sogs/ dgos pa yod do/ /de ltar na de dag gis rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing bzhi ru dbugs 'byin pa'am 'byin rung gi nus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /da longs sku'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'i dbang ni khyed rang rnams rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung gis 'dug la lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur lte 'og tu 'chings shing*/ mig ha rer gtsug tor rnam par blta ba'i lta stangs gyis/ yang glang po'i lta stangs mig thad drang du blta ba dang*/ seng ge'i mchongs stabs lag pa khu tshur bcas snying gi thad nas phar gdengs te mchongs stabs gyis la dbus phyogs rgyan stug po bkod pa'am/

dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i zhing khams su rig pa 'od kyi gong bu skar mda' ltar 'phangs pas phyir mi ldog pa'i nges shes gyis shig / ces brda sprad la/ gong ltar/ e ma/ skal ldan sems kyi bu gcig po nyin cig /de dag thams cad las sogs song zhig /a a āḥ zhes sku gsum las phyir mi ldog par rgyas gdab bo/ / des rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing bzhir rdzogs smin sbyang pa lo lnga brgyar mthar son te/ dbus phyogs dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i zhing khams su phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la dbugs dbyung ba'i nus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /de nas chos sku'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'i dbang ni khyed rang rnams chos sku seng ge'i 'dug stangs gyis la mig chos sku'i gzigs stangs gyen sprul sku'i gzigs stangs thur/ longs sku'i gzigs stangs g.yas dang g.yon du mig 'dril la mthar mig thad drangs su bzhag ste rang rig zang thal rjen pa'i ye shes skyes bu las zin lta bu rang babs su lhod de klod la tshig la snyan gtod 'tshal/ zhes brda sprad la/ e ma/ skal ldan sems kyi bu gcig po nyon cig /de las kyang 'das pa'i sogs nas/ slar ma ldog cig / bar brjod/ de nas don gsum pa dbang las thob pa'i ngo sprod bya ba la/ khyed rang sprul sku'i bzhugs stangs drang srong tsog pu ltar gyis la gzigs stangs mig cung thur du phab nas tshig gi don nges par zungs shig / ces/ e ma/ skal ldan sems kyi bu gcig po/ /sems nyid ngo bo sogs nas/ sprul sku lam 'dzin slar ma ldog cig / bar lan gcig/ yang longs sku'i bzhugs stangs gyis la mgrin pa thad drang du bzhag /mig cung zad dbab la slar tshig la snyan gtod 'tshal/ zhes/ e ma sogs nas slar ma ldog cig / bar lan gcig/ yang chos sku'i 'dug stangs kyis 'dug la mgrin pa bstod mig thad drangs su ltos la tshig la snyan gtod 'tshal/ zhes/ e ma sogs slar ma ldog cig

/ bar lan gcig go / de nas rang lus drang por rang babs su 'dug la don yid la zungs shig /de dag gi don cung zad bshad na sogs tshe 'di nyid la phyin par gyis shig / ces pa'i bar sgra dag la dal bus brjod par bya'o/ / de dag gis lam sgom rung dang*/ 'bras bu thob rung gi nus pa rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /don bla ma'i drung du man ngag gi dmar thag ma bcad na gang zag dbang rab rnams las/ 'bring man chad la gzhi lam gyi snang ba shan 'byed la bzlas ngo sprod dmar bcings su ma thob na go ba dang yin lo tsam gyis yid dpyod mthar 'dzin gyi phyogs su lhung nyen che'o/ / don gsum pa dbugs dbyung sogs nas/ thob pa yin no/ /zhes pa'i bar brjod la/ 'byor na dngos po'i maṇ+ḍal gyis dga' ston bya zhing*/ de'i dgos ched dang yon tan brjod pa ni/ dga' ston ni dbang gi rjes la sogs/ zhes gsungs so/ /bar brjod par bya/ mtha' khas len gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal sogs spyi ltar mtha' rgyas su bya'o/ /des rab tu spros med dbang gi zin tho grub zin pa yin no/ /e ma sku gsum rgyal bas 'gro khams rgya mtsho yi/ /gdul bya 'dul byed chos sgo mtha' yas bstan/ /kun gyi bcud phur rgyud lung man ngag sdai/ /ches cher yang zab 'od gsal rdzogs pa che/ /mthong thos tsam yang u dum wā ra lta'i/ /lam zab 'di 'dra'i smin grol bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /myong ba'i skal ba ldan pa'i nges shes ni/ / dngos sam rmi lam yin snyam dad gsum gyis/ /spro dga'i tshad la dpe zlar ma mchis kyang*/ /'di snang dga' ma'i bzhin la rab 'phyan pas/ /ji bzhin nyams su ma myong bdag 'dra dag/chu gter 'gram du skam reg gyis gdung ltar/ /bshad yam tshig dang rang mthong blun bsgom sogs/ /phyogs lhung chos brgyad gdon gyis bslus 'di la/ /bsam na skyo ba 'phel zhing mchi ma dku/ /kye ma/ da lta snyigs ma'i gdon gyis rab gzir rkyen/

/mkhas grub rgyu skar dbang po bstan 'gro'i dpyid/ /chu lhar phyogs shing mi mthun du mas gtses/ /mdo sngags bstan gnyis dbyings su gzim la nye/ /byas tshad don med duḥkha'i rgyu 'bras la/ / dbang med spyod rnams skyabs kyis skyob par dka'/ /da lta bzhugs dang slad nas 'byon gyur pa'i/ /ris med spong klog bstan 'dzin skyes chen rnams/ /smin grol gdams pas rang rgyud dag mdzod la/ /dus la babs tshe bstan 'gror phan bde'i ched/ / brgyud pa'i phyag len rgyud don dang mtshungs las/ /gzu lums ras chod dbang za ma yin pa/ /thal mo snying nas sbyar te gsol ba 'debs/ /log rtog khengs sems ma yin gcam bu bdag /bgrang bya son nas lhag bsam dag pa'i ngag /sba gsang med par drang por zhu ba lags/ /nongs par gyur na snying nas bzod par gsol/ /blun po'i rang mtshangs ston byed spel 'di la/ rang 'dod chos brgyad dug gis ma myos pas/ /legs pa'i cha mchis gyur na dus gsum gyi/ /dge tshogs lhan cig rgyal sras byang sems dang*/ /brgyud ldan bla mas yongs bsngos ji bzhin du/ /smon pa'i gnas kun 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces bcos min shugs 'byung gi bkyal tshig bcas rdzogs chen gzhi lam gyi smin grol ngo sprod legs par phul bas don la dbang 'byor ba 'grub dbang dam pa shākya shrīs kun phan gyi thugs bskyed kho nas lan gcig min par dngos brgyud nas bla ma yang tig yid bzhin nor bu'i dbang gi bskur thabs gang zag las dang po pa la go sla ba'i mtshams sbyar zhig dgos zhes gsung nan dngos po'i maṇ+ḍal bcas dang*/ gzhan yang lam 'dir gcig tu gus pa'i dam pa mang pos kyang yang yang bskul bas gsung ngo ldog min tsam du/ lugs gnyis kyi mdo shor ku sā li 7rig 'dzin sna tshogs rang grol rtsal zhes 'bod pa'i gdol spyod pos bla ma la gsol ba yang yang btab nas bris pa yang dpyad bcas shing 'brug ston zla ra ba ston pas chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug 'od phung du gshegs pa'i zla tshes dge
